Elena —

Short note to triage a couple of overlapping flight arrivals for the Northbridge two-day workshop on Sept 22. We have a mix of same-day arrivals and one long‑layover that could affect the scheduled 2pm onsite check‑in. Can you confirm the arrivals below and whether you want a single consolidated shuttle or split transfers? We want to avoid gate hold chaos.

Attendees we’re tracking: Samir (PM), Elena (sponsor), plus three engineers arriving later.

Flights I have:
- Samir Rao — AA 241, arrives SFO 12:45 PM (on time)
- Northbridge VP (Elena) — UA 980, arrives SFO 1:55 PM (tight but doable)
- Engineer block — multiple legs, some arriving 10pm (red eye)

Questions / proposals:
1) If Elena’s flight delays >30m we’ll swap to the 3pm coach pickup so Samir can cover initial check-in.
2) Suggest two shuttle runs: 1:30pm (priority: executives + facilitators), 3:45pm (remaining attendees).
3) Seat transfer/standby policy: if an attendee can take an earlier connection, we’ll reassign seats and update manifest. Dev — can you prepare a live manifest CSV we can update?

I’ve attached a working agenda and a draft manifest for your review (see attachments). If you prefer a single shuttle, say so and we’ll consolidate.

—Jordan
